description: Engine §10 accepts compatible inequality operands in `($x.without-elision.onward) ≠ "a"`.
grammar:
%const $S "ab"
%const $Q ("a" "b")
%const $TAG (A B)
%const $P @(A)
%const $E "a" ∖ "a"
%rule text $x:unit B %conditions ($x.without-elision.onward) ≠ "a"
%rule unit A
%rule family unit
%rule want A
